notes: SR97 AM.PM France (ampm.fr 301-redirects to laredoute.fr/pplp/cat-85201.aspx, brand-filtered subtree of La Redoute FR, per prior-pass access notes). ACCESS: curl_cffi (10 profiles) and Playwright both hit Cloudflare 'Un instant' JS challenge / 403 on all /pplp/*.aspx paths; WebFetch also returned 403 on every pplp path tried (worked only on the bare laredoute.fr homepage, 200). Used Claude-in-Chrome as the access route (tier 3) - the challenge auto-resolved on real-browser render, landing on the AM.PM-branded storefront (confirmed via 'AM.PM'-branded header/breadcrumbs on every page checked). CHECKS PERFORMED: (1) AM.PM top nav bar (all visible items: Nouveautes, Collection canapes, Collection linge de maison, Collection modulables, Votre canape/creation, customizable table, Professional area, Our stores) - no Bestsellers/Meilleures ventes/Top ventes item. (2) Full burger MENU panel (New products, Collection canapes, Collection linge de maison, 'Nos univers AMPM' full category tree: Furniture, Household linens, Lighting, Decoration, Tableware, Garden, plus Modular collection/Your sofa your creation/customizable table) - no Bestsellers node anywhere. (3) laredoute.fr site-wide has a genuine 'Best-sellers' page at /pplp/cat-385755.aspx, but it is a MULTI-BRAND curated landing page organized as horizontal carousels per department (Femme, Linge de maison, Lit literie, Canape fauteuil, Tapis, Enfant bebe, Table chaise, Meuble, Homme, Luminaire, Decoration, Art de la table, Jardin, Electromenager) - AM.PM products appear scattered inside several of these carousels alongside La Redoute Interieurs, Levi's, Adidas, Villeroy & Boch, etc, with no distinct AM.PM-only view and no single product count (it's carousels, not a paginated/countable PLP). Confirmed on the SAME page mechanism that a brand filter query param exists (observed '?brndid=la-redoute-interieurs' producing a brand-scoped 'Best-sellers LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS' page in a separate concurrently-open tab in this shared browser session) - tried the analogous '?brndid=am-pm' on cat-385755.aspx and it did NOT filter (page/title reverted to the generic unfiltered 'Best-sellers', slug not recognized), confirming no AM.PM-scoped bestseller view is exposed this way either. (4) Site search (virtualsite=85201, AM.PM-scoped) for 'meilleures ventes ampm' returned 'Il n'y a pas de resultat...' (no result) with a fallback default-match count (849) against unrelated products - a known false-positive pattern (default/non-discriminating search results), not evidence of a real listing. CONCLUSION: no genuine AM.PM-specific Bestsellers/Best-sellers/Meilleures ventes/Top ventes/Populaire merchandising PLP exists on this site; the only 'Best-sellers' page found is a general, cross-brand La Redoute landing page that does not represent AM.PM specifically and is not brand-filterable. Recording rows:[] as a correct absence finding.
